prompt_policy.api_cost_policy: Do not call OpenAI Images API or external paid image APIs.
prompt_policy.prompt_method: Fresh one-off prompts were written from the article title, refund decision, image role, and recent visual history.
prompt_policy.diversity_rule: Avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, cafe-table phone, and generic stock-travel scenes.
prompt_policy.quality_loop: Inspect each image and regenerate if generic, text-heavy, off-topic, repetitive, or internally similar.

images.alt: Two visual paths compare downtown and airport tax refund processing in Korea
images.caption: The hero comparison separates an earlier downtown refund from departure-day airport processing.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt rule. Image role: hero decision comparison for Korea Tax Refund: Airport or Downtown. Create a photorealistic editorial still life with a shared refund voucher branching to two clearly different paths: a downtown service counter with passport and payment card, and an Incheon departure counter with boarding-pass shape, unopened shopping bag, and inspection tray. Use a wide top-down three-quarter composition and restrained cream, blue, and coral. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, cafe-table phone, generic airport stock, readable text, letters, numbers, logos, QR codes, barcodes, fake app UI, and watermarks.

images.alt: Passport voucher unopened goods and departure validation arranged as a tax refund checklist
images.caption: Keep the passport, refund voucher, and unopened goods available until departure validation is complete.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt rule. Image role: inline process checklist for completing a Korea tourist tax refund. Create a photorealistic oblique tabletop sequence with four physical stations connected by a cord: neutral passport cover, blank refund voucher, sealed goods in an inspection tray, and a final validation token. Use tactile paper and fabric, pale stone, muted teal, amber, and a bright airport counter. Do not make this a second version of the hero image; avoid split-screen comparison, runway view, traveler with phone, shopping-bag-only scene, readable text, letters, numbers, logos, QR codes, barcodes, fake seals, app screens, and watermarks.
